note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 4(1)(4), Commonwealth Act no. 473 2, 4, 5, 17; A06b Const 4(1)(4), Commonwealth Act no. 473 2, 4, 5, 17; L05 Commonwealth Act no. 63 1(1) (as amended by Republic Act no. 9225, 2)): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Philippines, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in the Philippines for a continuous period of 10 years. ... n.a. ... Person is not a natural-born citizen and acquires citizenship of another country by naturalisation.
